name: Client billing summary
summary: Before an invoice goes out, the billing coordinator has a summary the client can read: fees by timekeeper, task and phase, expenses and write-downs, tied to the pre-bill. Every entry that breaks the client's billing guidelines reaches the responsible attorney as a decision, with the amount at stake.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared work: the client's guidelines and the firm's pre-bill as the only authorities, a tie-out before any drafting, every breach written as a decision for a named role, and a person who approves and sends.

sources.contribution: The shape of a client billing summary by timekeeper, task, phase, expenses and adjustments; describing in everyday words why each piece of work was done, with advice and strategy left out; and checking the bill against the client's billing guidelines, including several tasks under one time, duplicate entries and administrative work.
